ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the events, and the arrival and waiting conditions do check out - this case turns on a platform anti-farming guard, not on any dispute about the pickup, so the outcome is that the SGD 4.50 stays on hold until a person looks at it.

ARRIVAL AND WAITING (POL-NS-01). The trip record EV-TRIP-02751 shows a driver 'arrived' event at 22:31:15, and the GPS trace EV-GPS-02751 places the driver inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius from that same timestamp - limbs (a) and (b) hold. The trace shows one continuous qualifying in-geofence run of 408 seconds (22:31:15 to 22:38:03, 42 fixes), which is well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) - limb (c) holds. The trip was terminated by the driver at 22:38:07 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed at 22:34:15, with no boarding event - limb (d) holds. The fee is therefore chargeable under POL-NS-01 at SGD 4.50, and the fare ledger EV-FARE-02751 reconciles with the platform figure, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

WHY NO OTHER CLAUSE DISPLACES THE FEE. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply - the driver was inside the 50 m radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because the rider sent no locating or coordinating message; the only chat message, MSG-02751-001, is the driver's 'im at the pickup point'. POL-NS-05 does not fire - at 22:31:15 the driver was stationary at the pin (minimum distance 0.11 m, speed 0 kph), so the arrival marker is not false. POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall. The rider's own track (EV-GPS-02751, roughly 851-858 m from the pin) is not needed to decide the fee and does not change the result.

DRIVER PAYMENT AND THE ESCALATION. POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of SGD 4.50, i.e. SGD 3.60. That payout is withheld: the anti-farming check trips on the driver's own profile EV-DPROF-02751, where no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the threshold is 4 or more) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 equals 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. Both limbs are met, so compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). The escalation is terminal: no money moves automatically, and the SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE REVIEWER. Whether the driver's pattern - 4 no-show terminations in 30 days at a 0.10 rate against 40 completed trips - is fee-farming or ordinary volume. Under POL-NS-07, if it is not accepted the reviewer is directed to refund the rider's SGD 4.50 in full.

EVIDENCE AND DISCARDED CLAIMS. Two claims resting on the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02751-01 (weight 0.0) were discarded for not naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code (POL-GEN-02(1)); the advisory is absent in any event, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable and the single 408-second run already exceeds the minimum without it. The reference to rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags was flagged as a context-only field under POL-GEN-01; it is correctly not used as a ground of decision and grounds nothing here.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact that carries a deciding fact - EV-TRIP-02751, EV-GPS-02751, EV-DPROF-02751 and EV-FARE-02751 - has a weight of 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
